title: Admin Surface Design Guideline
summary: Binding admin-surface standard: flat full-bleed composition, compact disclosure-first headers, one grid for stream entries, non-redundant sober copy, project identity, operator-grade density, bounded prose width, theme tokens, and locally hosted fonts. Includes a fully specified Activity reference, a screenshot-backed violation audit, an incremental adoption contract, an explicit prohibition on nested outcome-summary boxes, the details-panel addendum, the append-only Navigation citizenship chapter with three light/dark Tree variants, a neutral waiting-decision counter recommendation, state rules, a follow-up slice boundary, visual Dos and Don'ts pairs, and an append-only Applied surfaces register. [Curation 2026-09-07: a standing reference with no operator decision pending. The former status "living-standard" and phase "accepted" were outside the descriptor vocabulary (status: active | decision-pending | decided | documented | archived) and made this dossier render as "Descriptor needs repair". The descriptor repair in develop corrected them to documented/informational, which keeps the standard fully readable under History instead of holding a slot in the active list; this curation pass adopts that value. AGENTS.md keeps the guideline mandatory reading for admin-surface work, so History here means lifecycle placement, not retirement.]
